name: Audio Post-Production and Mixing
description: A curated English-to-Simplified-Chinese glossary for audio post-production and mixing, covering dialogue editing, ADR, Foley, sound effects, sound design, restoration, re-recording, loudness, immersive formats, deliverables, software, and studio workflows.
author: youheng-alan-liu
